bear_points.claim: The trailing P/LTM-EPS of 19.8x sits at its own 0th percentile and EV/EBITDA 14.9x at the 3rd percentile over ~9 years, but this is largely an OPTICAL MISREAD: three of the last four quarters carry a below-the-line block netting +$81,812M (Q2-26 alone +$53,396M = 66% of pre-tax), so trailing EPS is inflated by non-operating gains and the low trailing P/E is not a clean 'cheap' signal.

On a forward operating basis the stock is NOT cheap: P/FY26E normalized EPS is 31.3x and NTM P/E 27.3x — above the peer-median NTM P/E of 18.2x — so the runway is substantially priced in once below-the-line gains are stripped out.
